subject: Sourcing: PO acceptance format, staggered weekly invoicing & net75 exception request
messages:
From: Jane Dawson <jane.dawson@orchidlabs.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: finance@orchidlabs.com
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: PO header requirements + weekly invoice lane (Net75 request)

Hi Marissa / Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Orchid Labs is excited to move forward, but procurement has a handful of constraints we need to resolve before we can issue a blanket PO. High-level asks from our side: 

1) PO header: our ERP requires a set of custom fields (entity_id, project_code, tax_entity, and GL cost center). Can Redwood accept those fields in the invoice and map them back to line items? We attached our PO template (Orchid_PO_Template_v2.pdf).

2) Invoice cadence: We prefer weekly invoicing tied to usage thresholds (staggered invoice schedule) rather than monthly statements. Is that supported? We need each invoice to reference the originating PO and the specific service usage lines.

3) Net terms: Procurement is requesting Net75 for our legal finance cadence. We realize standard vendors have shorter terms — can Redwood grant a Net75 exception for Orchid? We are evaluating a 12-month committed spend and would consider a volume discount in exchange.

4) Discounts & packaging: Curious whether committed usage can be packaged (e.g., baseline + burst pool) with tiered discounts and whether those discounts apply to usage overage.

Please advise what format you need for mapping and any internal approvals required on net terms. Happy to hop on a quick call if useful.

Thanks,
Jane Dawson
Procurement Lead | Orchid Labs
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jane Dawson <jane.dawson@orchidlabs.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO header requirements + weekly invoice lane (Net75 request)

Jane — thanks for the clear summary and the PO template. Appreciate the level of detail; this is straightforward to work through but will need a couple of coordination steps. Answers inline: 

1) PO header mapping: yes — we can consume additional PO header fields if Orchid includes them on the PO and on each invoice request. We use an ERP mapping table that can surface entity_id, project_code and GL tags on the invoice metadata. Key ask from our side: the PO must include a single canonical PO ID per billing entity. If Orchid needs multi-entity billing, please indicate which bill-to entity to use per PO line.

2) Weekly invoicing: supported. We can produce staggered/weekly invoices, but we need a consistent PO -> invoice reference mapping so our accounting system can reconcile. In practice that means: (a) PO contains canonical PO ID, (b) each invoice must list the PO ID and service-line identifier, (c) invoices cannot include multiple PO IDs across a single invoice file unless Orchid confirms consolidated processing.

3) Net75 exception: this requires approval from our finance leadership for standard terms. We do have flexibility for enterprise contracts with committed spend and an approved credit assessment. To fast-track, can you share the expected committed ARR range? As a starting point, we can provisionally accept Net60 with a commercial concession; Net75 will need a signed commitment (we typically use a quarterly true-up + rebate for longer terms).

4) Discounts & packaging: we support baseline + burst pools and tiered discounts. Discounts can be applied to committed baseline and optionally to overages (usually at a lower discount tier). We can draft 2 commercial options: (A) 10% discount on committed baseline ($200k+ ARR) with overage charged at list; (B) 6% discount plus a 3% early-pay credit if Orchid agrees to Net45 on a subset of invoices.

Attachments: Redwood_PO_Acceptance_Checklist.xlsx (attached) — please complete the highlighted fields and return so our billing team can add the mapping. Also, if you can flag which bill-to entity and which GL mappings are required we will mirror them.

Next steps / ask: please (1) confirm committed spend band you expect for the 12-month term, (2) return the completed checklist and (3) tell us whether weekly invoices should be consolidated per PO or per entity. Happy to set a 30-min sync if that's easier.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0192

Attachment: Redwood_PO_Acceptance_Checklist.xlsx
From: Jane Dawson <jane.dawson@orchidlabs.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: finance@orchidlabs.com
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 08:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO header requirements + weekly invoice lane (Net75 request)

Marissa — thanks for the quick reply. A few clarifying points from the finance team after reviewing your checklist: 

- Committed spend band: Orchid expects to start at ~$150k ARR but we anticipate scaling to ~$425k ARR across 12 months with expected seasonal peaks.
- Multi-entity: Orchid will issue POs per legal entity (three entities total). For now we prefer invoices per entity; weekly cadence per entity is fine.
- Overages: finance prefers discounts to apply to overage at the same tier as baseline (we understand this increases vendor exposure). If that's not possible, we can accept a slightly smaller overage discount.
- PO IDs: we can ensure a canonical PO ID per entity and include a project_code on each invoice line.

One more question: can Redwood emit the invoice in a CSV-friendly line-item export so Orchid's AP system can ingest automatically? That will determine whether invoices are batched vs individual files.

We completed the checklist and attached SOW_Summary.xlsx — please confirm once you have mapped the fields.

Thanks,
Jane
Procurement Lead | Orchid Labs
Attachment: Orchid_PO_Template_v2.pdf, SOW_Summary.xlsx
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Jane Dawson <jane.dawson@orchidlabs.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO header requirements + weekly invoice lane (Net75 request)

Jane — looping in from finance/leadership side to close this thread. Appreciate the clarity and the commitment trajectory you outlined. Proposal from Redwood: 

1) Net terms: we will approve Net75 for Orchid conditional on a signed 12-month commitment at or above $350k ARR (deal DL-8942). If Orchid signs at the $150k starting band we can offer Net60 with a 30-day early-pay discount of 1.5% (applies to invoices paid within 30 days).

2) Discounts & packaging: agree to baseline + burst pool. We will apply a 7% discount to committed baseline and a 3% discount to overages. If Orchid reaches $500k ARR in the 12-month term we will retroactively increase the baseline discount by 2% for the term.

3) Invoice format & cadence: weekly invoices per legal entity are supported. Redwood will produce invoice line-item CSV exports (one file per invoice instance) to support Orchid's AP ingestion. Required fields that must be present on the PO/invoice: canonical_PO_id, bill_to_entity, project_code, GL_cost_center. Please ensure the PO includes those values.

4) Processing & fees: we will waive any invoice-processing surcharge if a canonical PO per entity is used and Orchid accepts a consolidated remittance for each entity weekly.

Action items: 
- Orchid: sign the commercial term sheet / DocuSign powerform (link below) and return the completed PO checklist.
- Redwood: we'll produce a sample CSV invoice (for one week's usage) by EOD tomorrow for Orchid's AP to test.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abc123xyz
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/portal/8942/company/Orchid-Labs (for deal notes)

If this sounds acceptable we'll push legal a short SOW addendum and finalize the payment schedule.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Revenue — Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
